value.author: samMularczyk
value.layerInfo: Key out a range of a channel, with feathered edges.

channel: Which value the key is based on. Luminance is the usual choice; Red, Green, Blue and Alpha key off a single channel of the layer instead.
blackSoftness: Feathers the transition at the Black Point instead of a hard cutoff.
whiteSoftness: Feathers the transition at the White Point instead of a hard cutoff.
invert: Swaps kept for removed - the range between the two points becomes transparent instead of opaque.
